messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> SERVICE: synthetic-monitoring - Canary probes failing (TLS handshake) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty event: INCIDENT #INC-20247
  Severity: P1
  Trigger: canary-checker.europe-west1 - 78% failures in 5 min
  Symptoms: TLS handshake errors from probe collectors to monitoring API
  Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20247

ryan_oncall: acked. I'm jumping in. any idea what changed in the last hour?

ana_sre: saw a wave of cert-rotation jobs in monitoring namespace ~ 01:12 UTC. Could be related.

kim_runtime: we rolled a cert rotation job (auto) as part of infra cleanup. It touched monitoring-collector certs. I put a note in #eng-infra but didn't expect TLS to break probing.

ryan_oncall: can you paste logs from the collector?

kim_runtime: sure — tail from monitoring-collector (last 50 lines):
```
2026-03-14T01:15:03Z monitor-collector x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-14T01:15:04Z monitor-collector failed handshake with probe 10.4.3.22: tls: remote error: handshake failure
2026-03-14T01:15:10Z monitor-collector reloading certs from /etc/monitor/certs
2026-03-14T01:16:01Z monitor-collector connection error: EOF
```

ana_sre: that x509 error matches. certs rotated but new CA chain not trusted by probe clients. Some probes still use pinned CA bundle.

lee_support: any customer impact? support queue spiked with users complaining about slow document generation in EU. Could be tied.

ryan_oncall: paging surface looks like canary -> if the canary fails we have risk of false-negative health. But spikes in user-facing symptoms reported too. Assigning customer-impact to support to triage correlation.

lee_support: quick lookup: 12 distinct enterprise customers in eu-west-1 have elevated error rates on inference endpoints over the last 12 minutes. Correlation looks strong (same timeframe as probe failures).

kim_runtime: immediate mitigations I can run: roll back cert rotation (re-apply previous secrets), restart monitoring-collector pods, and temporarily disable TLS client verification on the collector so probes can re-register. Which should we do first?

ana_sre: prefer less blast radius: 1) disable TLS client verification on collector (config flag) -> will allow probes while we fix cert chain; 2) reapply old certs; 3) restart pods gracefully.

ryan_oncall: do it. Also please silence PagerDuty for synthetic-monitoring for 15m while we mitigate to avoid repeated noise. I'll mute.

infra-bot: Executing: `pd mute --service synthetic-monitoring --duration 15m --reason "ongoing cert rollback"`

pagerduty: Silence applied by ryan_oncall (15m).

kim_runtime: applying config change to disable client verification: `kubectl -n monitoring set env deploy/collector VERIFY_CLIENT_TLS=false`

kim_runtime: patched. rolling restart collector pods now: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/collector`

ana_sre: watching probe registrations...

kim_runtime: probes are starting to show SUCCESS in logs: `probe 10.4.3.22 registration OK`

kim_runtime: reapplying previous cert secret from vault: `kubectl -n monitoring apply -f certs/collector-old-secret.yaml`

kim_runtime: certs applied, restarting collector again to pick up certs.

ana_sre: quick smoke: running synthetic check CLI against monitor API: `./synth-check --endpoint eu-west1 --count 10` -> 9/10 ok, 1 timeout (flaky).

lee_support: support signals user error rates are trending back down for those 12 customers. Not fully normal but improving.

ryan_oncall: good. once stable for 10m we'll mark paging resolved and re-enable verification. Keep PD muted until fully green.

kim_runtime: re-enabled VERIFY_CLIENT_TLS=true now and restarted collector to ensure cert chain validated.

kim_runtime: collector logs show TLS handshake success: `handshake completed with probe 10.4.3.22`

ana_sre: monitoring graph shows canary failure rate dropped from 78% -> 2% over 6 minutes. Rolling average stabilizing.

ryan_oncall: I'm clearing the PD incident and leaving notes.

pagerduty: INCIDENT #INC-20247 -> RESOLVED by ryan_oncall. Resolution: rolled back problematic cert rotation and restarted collector; temporarily disabled TLS verification during mitigation; re-enabled after cert fix.

ryan_oncall: brief recap for postmortem: root cause = automated cert rotation job applied a CA chain not trusted by pinned probe clients (mismatch between new CA and probe bundle). Short-term fix = rollback certs + restart. Long-term action items: (1) add canary for cert rotation jobs in staging, (2) add rollout guard to ensure probe CA bundles updated before rotation, (3) add a graceful fallback to accept old CA for 30m during rotation.

jess_night: taking handoff for 02:00 UTC watch. I'll monitor canary and customer error rates, and follow up if it reoccurs.

ryan_oncall: thanks. tagging postmortem owners: @ana_sre @kim_runtime @infra-team.

incident-bot: note created: https://incidents.example/INC-20247/postmortem (draft)

ryan_oncall: closing thread; reach out if anything else pops back up. :white_check_mark:
